issues.description: Template method name mismatch in Exercise 1: the template defines a method named build_grover(...) but the class's run() method calls grover_circuit(...). The solution/reference implementation uses grover_circuit(...). This naming inconsistency will cause students who implement the provided build_grover(...) stub to still get an AttributeError (grover_circuit not found) when running the provided run() helper or when tests expect grover_circuit. It is a structural issue (method identity mismatch) rather than an intentional pedagogical gap.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the template method name consistent with the run() helper and the solution. Either (A) rename the template method build_grover(...) to grover_circuit(...) (and keep its signature/docstring), or (B) update run() to call build_grover(...). Prefer option (A) so the template matches the solution and the exercise task name (Grover circuit) used elsewhere. Also ensure the docstring and any tests reference the same method name.

issues.description: Exercise 1: The template and solution use different names for the method that assembles the Grover circuit. The problem statement and tests refer to the Grover circuit task as 'grover_circuit' (e.g. test_ex1_grover_circuit), the solution implements a method named grover_circuit, but the template provides a stub named build_grover while its own run() calls self.grover_circuit. This inconsistency (build_grover vs grover_circuit) creates confusion for students about which method to implement and can cause the provided run/test harness to fail or appear broken.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the method name consistent across artifacts. Rename the template stub build_grover to grover_circuit (and update its docstring if needed) so it matches the problem/test naming and the solution. Alternatively, update the template's run() to call build_grover and adjust the problem/test names to match—but the simplest fix is to rename build_grover -> grover_circuit in the template to align with the problem statement and solution.
